name: Ultimate Cart Obby
desc:
Jump into your cart and blast through a crazy track full of sharp turns, wild drops, and pure chaos! 😆 Hold tight, keep your balance, and try not to fly off the rails as the speed keeps climbing! 🚀

Control your cart, dodge obstacles, unlock new rides, and master every section of the track. Each part gets harder — but way more fun! 🎢🔥

Bring your friends, race side-by-side, or laugh together when someone gets launched into the void! 😭💨
